crossRefs.note: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who…

translations.web: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
translations.bsb: to preside over the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
translations.kjv: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
translations.asv: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
